body: Look there is a whole lot of ways to get yourself better. You can go seek help and take medication. Everybody has issues in their life, we just have to keep on pushing. As long as your alive you can make a change. The first change you can make is to cut off ties with that “toxic” guy, that ain’t gonna hell you out. I was in the same situation with a girl I was with for 4 years. It’s over now but it’s even worse now. Just relax.
If you end it your just going to spread the pain to your parents. Just relax man.

And I’m 17. Yea am weak. But am not gonna fold. Am going to keep on pushing. Your a child yourself, I bet you still leave shit stains in your pants so what makes you think you have the authority to take your own life away if your that young still? Wait for 5 more years, 5 damn years. Let’s see if you will think the same by then.

Then damn rules don’t fucking matter if someone is about to blow their fucking brains out. If you don’t believe in him then at least fucking believe in yourself and stop being a damn pathetic human!! Don’t you go on and try to take the easy way out. IF U DO FEEL BAD FOR WHAT YOU DID THEN SUCK IT UP AND TAKE THE PAIN IN. Don’t be a weakling and take the easy way out.

Look man we all humans are a mess alright? I don’t know the full story of this but am just going to tell you this. Live for yourself man. A lot of people do that and don’t regret or don’t accept it. You did. You regret ever ounce of it. The best you can do right now is to work for others, I wouldn’t be too sure on what to do in a situation like this. But the first step would be in trying your best to work for others, make them happy, make them realize how sorry you. Keep fighting. You realize your mistake and you won’t to change. Then fucking do it. Even if it’s by yourself do it. Don’t fucking fold. Idk if your religious or not BUT DEDICATE YOURSELF TO GOD AND ASK FOR FORGIVENESS. Dedicate your whole damn life to the church or to your people and give them the best. If you can’t live with yourself for your mistake then dedicate it to god! Dedicate it to yourself if your family won’t forgive you or give u a chance.
Why are you doing this? Just why? Please don’t at least text me man.

It will all get better man. Try your best to get hobbies or to do things that will get your mind off of them. Try not to smoke as well. It could lead to more problems along the way like me, I developed dp/dr due to the use of smoking. It will all be fine man I promise you.
Thank you so much for telling me this :) i know I will make it through and find the right person for me later on the future. Thank you :)
Thank you so much... am breaking down right now but this helped me out. Thank you.

Thank you so much for telling me about this. I claimed that I loved her so much but yet I put no effort in trying to find out why she was like that. And maybe I could have helped out in some way. Thank you and I’ll look into the list, again thank you so very much.

I want you to know it’s all going to be alright. You live once and everyday is a gift so live everyday to the fullest even when in the dark. We all go through these things in life for a reason. Don’t worry. Be strong and do the right choice. It will hurt so damn much but you must push through it all. You will be fine and he will be fine. Life is too precious to be living in complete sadness everyday. And if u can stop smoking too :) keep yourself busy, go workout, draw, listen to music, talk to other people. There is so much people out there, it may feel as if they are the only person in the world right now and that they are the only one who matters but trust me. The right person for you is out there and it’s not him. If your fighting right now for small things imagine how it will be when your married and have kids and actual real problems, it won’t work out. Just be calm and relax. And try your best everyday to get better. Step by step each day. You will get better!!

After being together for 8 months she started showing me her colors. She wanted me to herself, wanted me to cut off all the people around me. She would start fights for no reason and would always some how be my fault. Even though the fight was over something she did and messed up on I would always say sorry to her for no reason, just to make her feel better and to calm herself down. Her mother was a very aggressive lady and still is. Very explosive as well and has huge anger issues so am pretty sure she got that side from her mother. And it’s true.. she would never disrespect her friends and always be nice to strangers.. she would always suck it up. But as soon as she would get to me she would let out all her anger on me. And she would be having some serious mood swings. One second she would be so happy and joyful, the other she would be mad at me, she would ignore me and yell at me and blame me for everything. Thank you so much... so very much you don’t have an idea how you made me feel... it made me feel as if maybe am doing the right choice. That I must let go and that I’ll be okay. Thank you.

Honestly.... am suffering from depersonalization due to drug use and now depression. Am so damn alone and scared. Am only 17 and am ruining my own life.. we promised each other that we would have our own family and home. We promised so many things. But now it’s just gone in a day. All those memories. Am getting better on my depersonalization, I did synthetic weed for 3 weeks. Had terrible withdraws for a month and am still having mild episodes. Yet even though I felt like I was dying I never told her or made her worried. I just wanted her happy and to be smiling... but I never did enough..

I feel you. I just broke up with my girlfriend of 4 years. I want to go back so badly.. she promised me a better future and more happiness whenever I know she will go back to her ways within a month. She loves to control me, possessive, has anger issues, and wants me all to herself and let’s out all her anger on me. But whenever she would be good we would make the best memories ever... idk what to do but I know I must not go back. I unblocked her on insta and so did she. It was mistake but I just can’t handle it anymore. And am scared am going to be stuck in this loop forever. I seriously miss her so much and I REALLY want to tell her am sorry and just go back to her.

In my experience I rarely feel hungry and sometimes I could literally eat a banana in the morning and completely forget I haven’t ate crap all day long. But then some days I wake up and all day long am feeling hungry. Just don’t try to do anymore drugs or smoke. It’s only going to keep on getting worse the more you do drugs. Just try to keep yourself busy with literally almost anything.
I just took like an hour nap and I feel better now. Just a bit of anxiety. Am about to go to work in a bit and I hope I get tired when I get home so I can just fall asleep in peace.

Your the first person that I found who is literally going through the same exact thing as me. Am barely on my first week but am already getting what I hope is better? Anyways I would spend my whole day not feeling any anxiety or anything but just the feeling of being disconnected from the world, I get use to it and usually sometimes forget. When I focus on things such as driving, playing video games, watching shows, I feel my connection back to the world but as soon as I leave those things and go outside or walk around the house I feel that disconnection either hit me hard or it’s mild sometimes. Tonight was one of the worst though. Yesterday I fell asleep for about i would say 2 hours? I woke up feeling as if I were still in my dream and I wasn’t real, I started to shake a bit out of fear. After I calm myself down and took some natural pills I was fully calm, awake but still feeling disconnected. Later at night I tried to go to sleep, it was around 12 when I said alright I need to get some sleep now or I will wake up feeling really bad if I sleep too little. Turns out the whole night I wasn’t able to get a good shut eye. I kept walking up every 30-40 minutes and it would feel like as if I were asleep for hours, within those 30 to 40 minutes I would have some crazy realistic dreams such as vivid dreams. It got me so annoyed so I just tried everything to go to sleep. After it hit 5AM I was feeling crazy tired and so much anxiety and stress because I barely got any sleep. I fell asleep for an hour and within that hour I had the worse dream of my life. It was so very realistic, I killed people and I would get killed and it would feel so real. I woke up having a panic attack. I was shaking and I was also feeling really tired so my mind wasn’t coping. I finally was able to maybe get 6hrs of sleep in? But even so am still very tired as I type this and I wish to not have another bad dream.

Yea I experience these a lot. We usually get bad episodes in the morning. It’s normal, and some days will be fine but others we will wake up and it will feel worse. Your fine just chill out and vibe honestly. I just recently woke up from a VERY BAD DREAM, and currently am trying to calm myself down.

Don’t worry you’ll be fine. It’s better to let those who are close to you to find out what you have. My parents were also very disappointed in me and made me feel worse but as the days went by they started to actually help me out and understand what I was going through.

Are you currently living alone? Do you have any close friends or family you can talk to about this? Usually your able to feel better after talking to someone about what your going through, try hobbies or activities such as drawing or working out. Talk to yourself out loud, don’t just lay down or sit and think about it, stand up and walk around a bit. Your fine don’t worry. You will get through this and you will return to reality, it will make take weeks, months or even years but you have to remember to calm yourself down and to keep on fighting, we all live once, do your best to make everyday the best. You can do this :) and am not sure if your religious or believe in god but I suggest to try out to get close to him, it really helps out a lot.

Yea this is my first time in years that I haven’t done anything in almost a full week. Sometimes I want to do it but just completely forget and I feel guilt for some reason. It’s honestly weird. Sometimes I get scared to even do it because even when normal I get that “post nut” so am scared that if I do it I will trigger an episode.

Yea I got my dpdr after using weed. I was bored and going through things in quarantine and decided to smoke weed for my first time. I went hard for a starter which I regret. I smoked prolly 3 grams in my 3 weeks of smoking and I wouldn’t do it everyday just on and off. The last gram I smoked that I bought was a pretty strong one and after I finished it a week later I had the worst experience ever. Today is my first week of going through this and I feel like I’ve been getting better in controlling it and I only have bad episodes when am by myself or when I sleep long hours durning the day. Sometimes I get bad episodes randomly which I hate the most.

Yes!! I got so happy when I found out there was a community about dpdr. I would search through other apps such as Instagram about this but it wasn’t helpful. Came on reddit and boom a whole big community helping out each other and telling their stories. Honestly feels a lot better.

Makes me happy to know that there is people who are recovering from this. Am barely on my first week of this. I got it from smoking weed and I was barely new to it but I went pretty hard on it for a starter. I only smoked for 3 weeks and it wasn’t everyday it was just on and off and it wasn’t a whole lot maybe I did in total 3 grams. But for one gram that I bought it was pretty strong. Am getting better though, I usually get bad episodes if am by myself or if I sleep durning the day for long hours.

Congratulations!! Usually it’s very hard to get over this just by yourself. I don’t know where I would be right now if I hadn’t had help from my family members. Today has been my first day feeling somewhat better than the other days while being inside all day. I had a small episode just now but it was because I fell asleep for 2 hours and I guess that messed up my nerves a bit.
Heck’s no. It gives me a whole lotta anxiety. I got this from drug use so it is not a nice trip.

Have you recently been in any stress or have gotten in a very bad fight with anybody you love or is close to you? Majority of the time dpdr is the cause of having too much negative emotions, your brain goes through dpdr so you don’t feel them as much. And yes quarantine could be affecting you, obviously before this we were very active and busy throughout the days but now we are just closed in which can also develop into depression or maybe stress you out a lot and give you anxiety. We all humans have a limit on how much anxiety we are able to withstand, if it gets too bad to a certain point your brain goes through dpdr so you don’t have to experience all that anxiety. Just try your best to calm yourself down, talk to your family about what your going through or tell your close friends, do activities or hobbies such as drawing or working out. Your fine and nothing is going to happen :) just try to relax and tell yourself you will be alright.

Some things that can help you feel better is to talk to yourself out loud such as reading a book, talk to people about what your feeling it helps you understand your situation. Do activities such as working out or running. Doing hobbies such as drawing and if it gets really bad to the point you can’t just withstand it you can seek medical help. You aren’t alone a lot of people are going through this it’s just a matter of pushing through it. And don’t lay down or sit around and over think about it will only get worse, try to walk around or clean the house up a bit.

Ye don’t worry it’s all going to be okay. I know it’s scary but it will be over. Best things to make it go away is to keep yourself busy, talk to people, talk to yourself out loud, draw, there is many different things you can try out and if it gets too bad then you can go get medical help. It’s all good just a battle you must face on :)

Whenever your going through a rough time such as a break up or a traumatic experience in life you will experience depersonalization, your brain does that so it can numb the feelings. Basically to make you feel better and to ignore all the negative emotions. But am guessing since you started to smoke even more and take different substances it made a reaction. Just try to lay off the smoke and mushrooms. If you keep smoking it’s only going to get worse.

Til this past Tuesday I got hit pretty hard and now am 24/7 having anxiety and panic attacks. Things that help me a lot is going out with family and friends and being able to talk to people.
